attempts.outcome: The patched training function was run for 2 epochs on two throwaway run names with the training and validation sessions only (no test data read). Its epoch-1 and epoch-2 losses equalled the stored fold-1 runs to all printed digits. The two throwaway run folders were removed before the queue started; no test output existed at that point.

attempts.step: queue (16 trainings of 40 epochs, 32 evaluations, analyze)

looks_before_registration: The per-run tabulation of the stored v16 runs (selected epoch against Mahalanobis rejections, folds 0-4) was seen before the protocol was registered and is recorded in the protocol (seen_before_registration). No v17 output existed before registration.

replication_of_stored_runs.history: For all 16 runs the rerun history (train loss, validation loss, validation session-balanced accuracy) equals the stored history at every epoch the stored run reached.
replication_of_stored_runs.weights: For all 16 runs every tensor of the RULE checkpoint (model_rule.pth) is bit-identical to the stored model.pth (torch.equal on every state-dict entry); the file hashes differ only by serialisation.
replication_of_stored_runs.counts: STORED and RULE give identical counts for every score (Mahalanobis: 52/73 and 66/73). RULE is therefore not an independent replication: training on this machine is deterministic.
replication_of_stored_runs.stored_prediction_check: argmax of the stored TEST predictions equals the re-inferred logits in all 48 run entries; one VAL image of rgbe_loco_E30_E38_door_RH_f1_s42 (stored run and its RULE copy) differs between the two inference passes (near-tie), as already present in the stored run.

observations_not_in_the_claim_rule: LAST changed which doors were rejected although the totals were close. RGB: E30 LH FRT 8/9 -> 3/9, E38 LH FRT 0/4 -> 4/4, E30/E38 RH 0/14 -> 1/14, E25 LH FRT 0/2 -> 0/2. RGBE: E30 LH FRT 8/9 -> 9/9, E38 LH FRT 0/4 -> 3/4, E25 LH FRT 0/2 -> 0/2.

In 12 of the 16 runs the validation session-balanced accuracy at the rule epoch equals that at epoch 40 (0.929 in 10 runs, 1.0 in the two E25 LH FRT runs); the early rule epochs were decided by the tie-break (lowest validation loss), not by a higher accuracy. In the other 4 runs the rule epoch had a higher validation accuracy than epoch 40.

Output-based scores with LAST rejected 38/73 (RGB, all three scores) and 27-38/73 (RGBE), against 24-32/73 and 25-32/73 with the rule checkpoints. Closed-set accuracy of the registered doors: 511/511 with LAST, 510/511 and 509/511 with the rule checkpoints.
Validation-door threshold (Mahalanobis): RULE 44/73 and 46/73, LAST 44/73 and 58/73.
manuscript_use: Case (a) of the registered claim rule: section 4.4 states the last-epoch counts (52 and 70 of 73) next to the rule counts (52 and 66) and that the composition of the rejected doors changed for the RGB CNN; the conclusion keeps its statement. Tables 5 and 6 (formerly 6 and 7) keep the stored results.
